label: An endless populated past would admit a Grim Reaper system of locally ruled stations
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (Grim Reaper patchwork style): for every accessible history and every strictly descending sequence of its moments starting at a moment where a contingent concrete individual is present, some Nat-indexed system of stations satisfies the four local rules of the indexed signal Reaper (index admissibility, positive trigger, emission, forwarding), station n read as placed at the n-th moment. The rules are causal; mere temporal precedence contains no stations. Given the verified impossibility of such a system, the bridge is equivalent to the founded populated pasts it is used to derive.
